 iOS 27.3 Beta 2 Now Available for Developers
 Monday November 16, 2026 10:07 am PST by Juli Clover Apple today seeded the second betas of upcoming iOS 27.3 and iPadOS 27.3 updates to developers, with the software coming two weeks after the first betas were released .
Registered developers can download the betas by going to Settings > General > Software Update and opting in to the developer beta.
 iOS 27.3 adds a new Vertical Tabs layout option that moves Safari tabs to the left side of the display. There's also an Adaptive Dark Mode for Safari that can turn light sites darker when ‌Dark Mode‌ is activated.
 Siri AI can do more in and across apps with support for actions in Calendar, Files, Journal, Mail, Maps, Messages, Music, Notes, Photos , Preview, Reminders, Safari, Shortcuts, and Weather.
 The new Health app is back, the iPhone Duo now supports Reachability, and there's a new Apple Music Selfie Sing feature if you want to capture videos of yourself while you do karaoke. There are more features too, with a list available in our iOS 27.3 beta guide .
 iOS 27.3 will come out in December.
